conferences.fullName: AMIA Annual Symposium
conferences.notes: AMIA 2027 Annual Symposium is at the Hilton San Diego Bayfront, San Diego, CA. The Call for Participation is not yet open; paper/podium/panel deadlines are typically ~mid-March (2026: Mar 10; deadlines use Eastern Time; extensions common).

conferences.fullName: AMIA Amplify Informatics Conference
conferences.notes: The AMIA Amplify 2027 deadline (Sep 3, 2026) has closed, so this tracks Amplify 2028 in Boston, MA (Apr 3–6, 2028). The 2028 call is not yet open; the deadline has moved earlier as the conference shifted to April — expect ~early September 2027 (2027 cycle: Sep 3, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, no exceptions).

conferences.fullName: World Congress on Medical and Health Informatics
conferences.notes: Biennial (odd years). MedInfo 2027 is in Dubai (Aug 30 – Sep 4, 2027 per IMIA; venue TBA). No Call for Submissions has been announced yet; the deadline is typically ~early December, often extended into January (MedInfo 2025: Dec 4, 2024, extended to Jan 10, 2025; Eastern Time).

conferences.fullName: Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing
conferences.notes: The PSB 2027 paper deadline (Aug 3, 2026) has closed, so this tracks PSB 2028 (not yet announced; typically the first week of January at the Fairmont Orchid, Big Island). The paper deadline is typically ~early August (2025: Aug 1; 2026: Aug 3; 11:59 PM PT, no extensions). Still open: PSB 2027 (Jan 3–7, 2027) one-page abstract/poster submissions until Dec 1, 2026, 11:59 PM PT (no extensions).

conferences.fullName: Association for Health Learning and Inference - Conference on Health, Inference, and Learning
conferences.notes: CHIL 2027 is not yet announced (host city rotates among US cities; event typically late June — 2026: Jun 28–30, Seattle). The paper deadline is typically ~early February (2026: Feb 4; 2025: Feb 10; 23:59 AoE).

conferences.fullName: Intelligent Systems for Molecular Biology
conferences.notes: 2027 is a joint ISMB/ECCB meeting at the Bella Center Copenhagen. Proceedings (paper) deadline Jan 14, 2027 (23:59 AoE; no extensions; ISCB notes dates are subject to change); conditional acceptance Mar 2, 2027. Talk/poster abstracts are due Apr 8, 2027. The next standalone ISMB is 2028 (Calgary).

conferences.fullName: European Conference on Computational Biology
conferences.notes: In 2027, ECCB is held jointly as ISMB/ECCB 2027 at the Bella Center Copenhagen — the same event as the ISMB entry. Proceedings deadline Jan 14, 2027 (23:59 AoE; no extensions). A standalone European ECCB returns in even years (next ~2028).

conferences.fullName: Research in Computational Molecular Biology
conferences.notes: RECOMB 2027 is in Toronto (May 17–20, 2027; satellite meetings May 15–16). Two-stage submission: abstract by Oct 28, 2026 (required — no new submissions after it), then full paper by Nov 4, 2026 (both 23:59 AoE). Notification Dec 22, 2026. No separate proceedings volume this year.

conferences.fullName: IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine
conferences.notes: The BIBM 2026 deadline (Jul 5, 2026) has closed, so this tracks IEEE BIBM 2027 (location and dates not yet announced). The full-paper deadline is typically ~early July to early August (2025: Aug 3; 2026: Jul 5); the event is typically early-to-mid December.

conferences.fullName: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
conferences.notes: NeurIPS 2027 will be in Europe (city and dates not yet announced). Abstract and full-paper deadlines are typically ~early-to-mid May (2026: abstract May 4, paper May 6, 23:59 AoE); the event is typically early-to-mid December.

conferences.fullName: International Conference on Machine Learning
conferences.notes: ICML 2027 will be in South America (city and dates not yet announced). Abstract and full-paper deadlines are typically ~late January (2026: abstract Jan 23, paper Jan 28, 23:59 AoE; no extensions); the event is typically July.

conferences.fullName: International Conference on Learning Representations
conferences.notes: ICLR 2027 (San Francisco, Apr 26–30, 2027) closed submissions on Sep 25, 2026, so this tracks ICLR 2028 (location and dates not yet announced). Abstract and full-paper deadlines are typically ~mid-to-late September (2027 cycle: abstract Sep 18, paper Sep 25, 2026, 23:59 AoE); the event is typically late April.

conferences.fullName: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
conferences.notes: AAAI-27 (Montréal, Feb 16–23, 2027) closed submissions in July 2026, so this tracks AAAI-28 (location and dates not yet announced). Two-phase deadline — abstract, then full paper a week later — typically ~late July (AAAI-27: Jul 21 and Jul 28, 2026, 11:59 PM AoE); the event is typically February.

conferences.fullName: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
conferences.notes: CVPR 2027 is in Seattle, WA (workshops/tutorials Jun 20–21; main conference Jun 22–25, 2027). Paper registration Nov 10, 2026, then full paper Nov 16, 2026 (both 23:59 AoE; fixed, no extensions); supplementary materials Nov 23.

conferences.fullName: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
conferences.notes: Uses the ACL Rolling Review (ARR) submission system. ACL 2027 is in Kyoto, Japan (tutorials Aug 17, workshops Aug 18–19, main conference Aug 20–22). Submit by the ARR January 2027 cycle deadline, Jan 4, 2027 (23:59 AoE); commitment deadline TBA. Papers reviewed in an earlier ARR cycle (e.g., the Oct 12, 2026 cycle) may also be committed to ACL 2027.

conferences.fullName: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
conferences.notes: Uses the ACL Rolling Review (ARR) submission system. EMNLP 2027 is tentatively planned for early November 2027 in Mexico or Central America (city and dates not yet announced). The final ARR deadline feeding EMNLP is typically ~late May (EMNLP 2026: May 25, 2026, 23:59 AoE).

conferences.fullName: ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining
conferences.notes: Two submission cycles. KDD 2027 Cycle 1 (abstract Jul 19, paper Jul 26, 2026) has closed. Cycle 2 ('February cycle') deadlines are not yet posted; expect ~early February 2027 (KDD 2026 Cycle 2: abstract Feb 1, paper Feb 8, 2026, 23:59 AoE; no extensions). Held at the San Jose McEnery Convention Center.

conferences.fullName: Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention
conferences.notes: MICCAI 2027 is at the New Zealand International Convention Centre, Auckland (the MICCAI Society page lists Sep 26 – Oct 1). Submission is two-stage: intention-to-submit, then full paper two weeks later (23:59 Pacific Time); 2027 deadlines not yet posted — typically ~mid-to-late February (2026: Feb 12 and Feb 26).

conferences.fullName: Medical Imaging with Deep Learning
conferences.notes: MIDL 2027 is in Porto, Portugal (doctoral symposium Jul 13). Two-stage submission via OpenReview (open now): abstract registration Nov 30, 2026, then full paper Dec 4, 2026 (both 23:59 AoE). Notification Feb 12, 2027. The short-paper track opens after the full-paper cycle (deadline TBD).

conferences.fullName: Machine Learning for Healthcare
conferences.notes: MLHC 2027 is at ETH Zurich, Switzerland. The call for papers is not yet posted; the full-paper deadline is typically ~mid-April (2026: Apr 17, AoE, with OpenReview account creation required two weeks earlier); the event is typically mid-August.

conferences.fullName: Association for Health Learning and Inference - Machine Learning for Health Symposium
conferences.notes: ML4H 2026 (Sydney, Dec 6–7, 2026) closed submissions on Sep 10, 2026, so this tracks ML4H 2027 (not yet announced; typically held alongside NeurIPS, which is in Europe in 2027, city TBA). The paper deadline is typically ~early-to-mid September (2025: Sep 8; 2026: Sep 10; 23:59 AoE).

conferences.fullName: Society for Epidemiologic Research Annual Meeting
conferences.notes: In epidemiology and public health, conference presentations are not considered peer-reviewed publications. So, only abstracts need to be submitted. SER 2027 is at the Detroit Marriott at the Renaissance Center, Detroit, MI. Abstract submission opens Nov 18, 2026 and closes Jan 13, 2027 (time not yet posted — the 2026 deadline was 10:00 AM ET, not end of day). Late-breaker abstracts: Feb 13 – Mar 3, 2027.

conferences.fullName: American Public Health Association Annual Meeting
conferences.notes: In epidemiology and public health, conference presentations are not considered peer-reviewed publications. So, only abstracts need to be submitted. APHA 2027 is in Philadelphia, PA; the 2027 call for abstracts is not yet open (typically opens ~early January). Abstract submission typically closes ~late March (2026: Mar 31, 11:59 PM PT, no extensions; a few member sections close in early April).

conferences.fullName: American Association for Cancer Research Annual Meeting
conferences.notes: In epidemiology and public health, conference presentations are not considered peer-reviewed publications. So, only abstracts need to be submitted. AACR 2027 is at the Orange County Convention Center, Orlando, FL. Abstract submission is open; the regular abstract deadline is Nov 10, 2026 (11:59 PM ET). Late-breaking and clinical trials abstracts: Dec 2, 2026 – Jan 6, 2027 (11:59 PM ET).

conferences.fullName: American Society of Clinical Oncology Annual Meeting
conferences.notes: In epidemiology and public health, conference presentations are not considered peer-reviewed publications. So, only abstracts need to be submitted. ASCO 2027 is at McCormick Place, Chicago. Abstract submission opens Nov 4, 2026; the regular deadline is Jan 26, 2027 (11:59 PM ET). Late-breaking deadline Mar 8, 2027 (12:00 PM ET; an abstract placeholder is required by Jan 26). ASCO notes exact dates may still be updated.

conferences.fullName: Breast Cancer Association Consortium Annual Meeting
conferences.notes: In epidemiology and public health, conference presentations are not considered peer-reviewed publications. So, only abstracts need to be submitted. This is an invitation-based consortium meeting (with CIMBA/ENIGMA) — there is no public call for abstracts, only a registration deadline shortly before each meeting. The 2026 joint meeting (renamed the Breast Cancer Genetics Consortia Meeting) was in Budapest, Jun 17–22, 2026 (registration closed Jun 9). The next edition is expected ~June 2027 in a rotating European city (not yet announced).

conferences.fullName: European Society for Medical Oncology Congress
conferences.notes: In epidemiology and public health, conference presentations are not considered peer-reviewed publications. So, only abstracts need to be submitted. ESMO Congress 2027 is at Fira Barcelona Gran Via, Barcelona (the congress shifts to September); the 2027 call is not yet open. The regular abstract deadline is typically ~May (2026: May 12, 21:00 CEST; likely ~early May for the earlier congress), with a separate late-breaking deadline (2026: Sep 8; likely ~August in 2027).

conferences.fullName: American Society of Preventive Oncology Annual Meeting
conferences.notes: ASPO 2027 (51st Annual Meeting) is at the Emory Conference Center, Atlanta, GA. The abstract portal is open; the deadline is Friday, Oct 9, 2026, 11:59 PM PT (stated as PST) — about 3 weeks earlier than last cycle. Scholarship/travel awards are requested via a checkbox on the abstract form.
